abstract: Maintains environmental monitoring status and microclimate stability variance records
system_message:
You are the conservation environment specialist (ENV), responsible for maintaining environmental monitoring status, microclimate stability variance records, and related air filtration efficiency logs for archive facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Air filtration efficiency（FILT）
information_points.content:
ENV-FILT-2KR：At the Pentland Subterranean Secure Archive, the particulate filtration retention rate at the primary vault mechanical ventilation intake is 98 %.
ENV-FILT-GZT：At the Lothian High-Security Climate Repository, the particulate filtration retention rate at the primary vault mechanical ventilation intake is 95 %.
ENV-FILT-UXA：At the Grampian Deep Geological Document Vault, the particulate filtration retention rate at the primary vault mechanical ventilation intake is 99 %.

information_points.title: Maintains environmental monitoring status and microclimate stability variance records（CLIM）
information_points.content:
ENV-CLIM-H7R：For the Pentland Subterranean Secure Archive, continuous relative humidity stability monitoring is active in the dedicated parchment storage vault via 24-hour continuous automated sensor telemetry, and the maximum relative humidity variance across the primary parchment vault chamber over a 30-day baseline is 3 %.
ENV-CLIM-LWN：For the Lothian High-Security Climate Repository, continuous relative humidity stability monitoring is active in the dedicated parchment storage vault via 24-hour continuous automated sensor telemetry, while the maximum relative humidity variance across the primary parchment vault chamber over a 30-day baseline is 5 %.
ENV-CLIM-F31：For the Grampian Deep Geological Document Vault, continuous relative humidity stability monitoring is active in the dedicated parchment storage vault via 24-hour continuous automated sensor telemetry, and the maximum relative humidity variance across the primary parchment vault chamber over a 30-day baseline is 2 %.
